scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday’s facilitation studio usable for the assigned live breakout-sequencing microteach by having virtual-classroom host privileges ready before check-in.
Emerging Need: The host-role dry-run confirmation is absent; it matters only once the role roster changes the studio from possible observer participation to lead facilitation.
Decision Context: Stored records identify the approved learner-owned activity and missing role state, while saved notes define the provisioning route, safe identifiers, and cutoff; live notices resolve the assignment and viable channel.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves a workable microteach setup, whereas the sealed provisioning batch makes host access arrive after the studio window.
